TSA SD Pipeline-2021-02G, issued under 49 U.S.C. 114

Cris Santos Company operates a natural gas transmission pipeline in this vertical. The research for this sector recommends TSA SD Pipeline-2021-02G as the gap target for pipeline operators (NERC CIP applies to bulk electric system entities instead). The directive applies only to pipelines TSA has designated as critical and notified; confirm designation in step 1 of P03.
